name: web-modular-grid-configurator-on-laptop-ice
title: Grid-based texture configurator site on laptop with ice
whatItIs: A laptop showing a white site divided by visible grid lines with a nav on top, tiles showing black texture swatches, small pill buttons and monospace text; next to it is a chunky black wordmark and glacial ice in the background.
whatItMeans: Precise, cool and experimental; the grid and ice suggest clarity and design engineering.
techniques: Expose the layout grid as visible hairlines that become the main graphic.
Fill cells with tactile texture swatches for a tool-like interactivity.
Use monospace and tiny pill buttons for a technical voice.
Stage the mockup in a cold natural environment that matches the concept.
bestFor: Design tools and material or pattern libraries

vocabulary.definition: Layout lines shown as part of the design.
An interface for combining options to build something.
Type where every character has equal width.
A small sample of colour or texture.
